card.name: Oncology dosing text: numbers and drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces inside oncology dose schedules, such as digits and commas in numbers like 9,600 units, and partway through names like pembrolizumab or BAVENCIO. Also 'than' or 'the' in cancer-drug dosing or trial sentences.

modes.label: Digits inside dose numbers
modes.description: Comma or digits within a multi-part dose figure in an every-few-weeks schedule.
modes.example: doses of 395 mg/4,800 units every 3 weeks or 4 doses of 790 mg/9<<,>>600 units every 6 weeks

modes.label: Inside cancer drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of names such as pembrolizumab or BAVENCIO.

modes.label: Linking words in thresholds
modes.description: The word 'than' in 'less than' before a QT interval limit.
modes.example: Initiate VANFLYTA only if QTcF is less<< than>> or equal to 450 ms
